description: Figure 9 illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on accuracy, categorized by part-of-speech tag. The horizontal axis represents the part-of-speech tag, labeled with abbreviations such as “N,” “V,” “R2,” and “R1,” in an unspecified order. The vertical axis represents the effect on accuracy, labeled “E(m, t, p)” and measured as a percentage, with a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1.  The chart consists of a series of single bars, each representing a specific tag. The bars vary in height; for example, the bar for “R2” is approximately 0.05, while the bar for “N” is approximately -0.1. All bars are a uniform color. Error bars are present atop each bar, indicating the standard deviation, but their exact lengths are not readily quantifiable. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
